reuse.why: Routes the template, forecast, posting, preview and API sites through the existing getScheduledAmount helper, but re-implements the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts, which the matcher already uses.

duplication.why: Five midpoint copies are collapsed into getScheduledAmount, yet the approximate-amount tolerance formula is duplicated from getApproxNumberThreshold and updateActions keeps its own null/number dispatch around the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount where amount semantics already sit; the only misplaced piece is the tolerance, which belongs to shared/rules.ts.

scope.why: Edits are limited to amount computation, the API field, tests and comments, though some comments are left stale (forecast and updateActions still say 'furthest from zero' after step 4).

maintainability.why: One helper now owns most of the rule, but the boolean-then-optional-op positional signature, a site that ignores op, a copied tolerance constant and stale comments would trip up the next change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: updateActions in server/schedules/app.ts keeps its own `amountValue == null ? 0 : typeof === 'number' ? amountValue : getScheduledAmount(amountValue)` dispatch and passes no op, so approximate amounts skip the rule there; getScheduledAmount itself bypasses getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount's isapprox branch in shared/schedules.ts rewrites getApproxNumberThreshold's `Math.round(Math.abs(n) * 0.075)` as a local `tolerance` variable rather than calling the shared function.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an optional op parameter and an isapprox special-case branch; updateActions (server/schedules/app.ts) still dispatches number/range itself and does not pass op.
